profile.name: Raj Shah
profile.tagline: Production AI / ML Engineer building reliable, evaluation-driven AI systems.
profile.specialization: Production ML Systems · RAG · Evaluation · Deployment
profile.bio: Computer Science + Data Science graduate from Rutgers University. I build AI systems that combine deterministic validation, retrieval grounding, scalable pipelines, and LLM-assisted reasoning.

experience.summary: Built production-oriented geospatial ML pipelines for subsurface exploration and multimodal data fusion, focusing on preprocessing, validation, evaluation, and batch inference workflows.
highlights: Built an end-to-end ML pipeline classifying lithology across 4 geological datasets, achieving ~68% accuracy.
Standardized multi-source datasets using Pandas and Parquet, reducing preprocessing errors by ~20%.
Engineered preprocessing and validation workflows to improve data quality across dynamic batch prediction inputs.
Developed batch inference pipeline with predict_proba confidence scoring for dynamic prediction inputs.

experience.summary: Delivered stakeholder-facing analytics with validated datasets, ETL workflows, optimized SQL, and Tableau dashboards.
highlights: Cleaned and validated 1,500+ records using SQL and Python, improving data accuracy by ~25%.
Developed ETL workflows for transformation, reducing manual reporting time by ~25% overall.
Built Tableau dashboards for 100+ stakeholders, improving KPI reporting efficiency by ~25%.
Optimized SQL aggregation/filtering queries to improve retrieval efficiency and processing speed.

projects.title: EvacAI — AI-Powered Disaster Preparedness Platform
projects.subtitle: IBM Z × UNSA Hackathon · iOS + deployed web platform
projects.description: Built EvacAI to help users respond during floods, hurricanes, wildfires, earthquakes, and severe weather with live weather, disaster alerts, shelters, ML-based risk scoring, and AI-generated evacuation plans. FastAPI backend integrates geocoding, alerts, weather, resources, and planning; IBM watsonx/Granite and Cloud Object Storage power AI response planning.
projects.metrics: Full-stack platform · Live weather + risk scoring · Global location support

projects.title: FOMC Yield Curve Prediction Using NLP & Machine Learning
projects.subtitle: 189 FOMC statements (1994–2024) + FRED macro features
projects.description: Predicted short-term U.S. Treasury yield movements using Federal Reserve language and macro data. Engineered NLP features with TF-IDF drift, hawkish/dovish lexicons, and FinBERT sentiment; trained Ridge, Lasso, Random Forest, and XGBoost with walk-forward validation to reduce look-ahead bias.

projects.title: RU-PATH — AI-Powered Parking & Transit Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Rutgers-focused RAG assistant for parking + bus routing
projects.description: Built a LangChain + DeepSeek RAG chatbot covering 5 permit types and 6 bus routes with semantic search, NLU intent routing, and modular parking/routing engines. Flask REST APIs support real-time multi-turn queries across campuses; deployed with Docker, GitHub Actions, and Render.
projects.metrics: ~89% response accuracy · 99% production uptime · 1,500+ lines modular Python

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Classification with Deep Learning
projects.subtitle: LeNet + STN-LeNet on MNIST (PyTorch)
projects.description: Built CNN image classifiers in PyTorch with data preprocessing and augmentation, achieving 98.9% test accuracy and reducing classification error by ~35%. Used cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to improve validation accuracy and analyzed predictions with confusion matrices.

projects.title: Automated Data Collection & Analysis Pipeline
projects.subtitle: The Marcus Harris Foundation · Python + Selenium + SQL ETL
projects.description: Built an end-to-end ETL pipeline processing 1,000+ records with validation and deduplication, cutting manual collection from 10+ hours/week to under 2 hours (~80% reduction). Generated automated dashboards and reports for 100+ stakeholders.
projects.metrics: ~80% time reduction · 200+ inconsistent records removed · 100+ stakeholders

projects.title: Broadway Grosses Analysis & Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Python + SQL analytics with Tableau storytelling
projects.description: Analyzed 2,000+ Broadway gross revenue records to surface pricing, attendance, and capacity trends. Improved dataset accuracy by ~20% through cleaning workflows and built interactive Tableau dashboards; applied linear regression (R) for forecasting (R² ~0.70+).

projects.title: Airline Booking & Reservation Management System
projects.subtitle: Java + MySQL full-stack reservation system
projects.description: Developed a full-stack airline reservation system with RBAC for customers, admins, and representatives. Built flight search/filtering, booking lifecycle workflows (confirmation, cancellation, waitlist), normalized MySQL schema, and admin/support modules.
